segment_summary: কালবৈশাখীর আগমন আসন্ন, যা মানবীয় ইচ্ছার বিপরীতে প্রকৃতির অনিবার্য হস্তক্ষেপের পূর্বাভাস দিচ্ছে।

segment_enrichment.angle: Focus entirely on the physical manifestation of the traveler's internal contradiction—a hand trying to apply precise scientific knowledge (e.g., measurement tools) onto a surface that only accepts intuitive touch.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: The precise point where plaster has flaked off, revealing the underlying earth; Desire: To impose a digital grid overlay onto this flaw to map its 'history,' Obstacle: The fine red dust refuses any linear measurement.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Treating the 'Savior Complex' as a specific symptom of urban alienation rather than an abstract vice.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: Sight: The precise hue difference between the dried-out lime plaster and the living red pigment of a stray plash flower growing on its surface.
segment_enrichment.research_question: How does the visual quality of light change when passing through dense clouds composed primarily of red iron oxide particles?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: A highly rhetorical internal monologue delivered entirely through short, declarative, almost brutal statements to contrast the perceived grandiosity of the ruin.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: This chapter is materially different by centering entirely on the internal conflict—the cognitive clash between ordered knowledge and chaotic reality—whereas neighbours focused more on external observation or philosophical reception.
